C.3 Open research questions (drawn from the Gaps lists of all version-2 notes and version 1) Each question becomes a register entry or a library task on first pass. Where a question names a source, that source is the next place to look. Timeline and positions 1. What were the exact nightly positions of the III, V, VI and II Corps on June 28-29 and of Longstreet’s corps June 26-30? (Official Records vol. 27 Part 3 dispatches; Coddington.)

2. Where exactly were Buford’s June 29 Fairfield/Emmitsburg route and his June 30 vedette positions, and the July 1 pre-dawn pickets on Marsh Creek and the roads? (Official Records, Buford and brigade reports; Gamble and Devin reports.)
3. What civilian activity occurred in Gettysburg at dawn on July 1 and on the night of July 1? (Civilian diaries in GettDigital; Pierce, Myers, McCreary, Broadhead, Thorn.)
4. What were the arrival times of the Artillery Reserve (Tyler/Hunt) and Hunt’s overnight battery placement? (Hunt and Tyler reports, Official Records.)

5. What were the overnight positions of Anderson (Hill’s corps) and Rodes on July 1-2, and the hour of Lee’s conversations with Longstreet on July 3 and any council of war? (Rodes and Anderson reports; Longstreet and Alexander accounts, treated as Tier 3.)
6. When did Reynolds die, when did Ewell decide not to press Cemetery Hill, and when did Hancock arrive? (Official Records; Pfanz; Coddington.)
7. When was Sickles wounded, and what do the Official Records of Sickles, Birney and Humphreys say about the III Corps timeline? (Those reports.)
8. What were the times of the Hunterstown charge and of Custer’s movement to Gregg on July 3, and Hampton’s wounding (conflicting)? (Custer, Pennington, Hampton, Gregg reports.)

9. What did the 20th Connecticut, 2nd Maryland Eastern Shore and 1st Maryland Eastern Shore do on July 3? (Official Records and regimental histories.) Uniforms, arms and soldier types 10. What primary armament did each Union regiment carry (Dean Thomas’ appendix), and what did the regiments with no datum (1st Minnesota, 14th Brooklyn, 114th PA, 26th NC, Texas Brigade remainder, Pickett’s brigades) carry? (Coates and Thomas; ordnance returns in NARA RG 156; regimental histories.)

11. How did the 5th Michigan obtain its Spencers and in what numbers, and what revolvers did each of Buford’s regiments carry (the forum figure is unverified)? (Michigan at Gettysburg; ordnance reports.)
12. What were the specifications of the Gallager, Smith, Merrill, Starr, Joslyn, Maynard and Sharps and Hankins carbines used by cavalry? (Coates and Thomas; ordnance manuals.)

13. What did Stonewall Brigade, Kershaw, Barksdale, Law, Wilcox, Perry, Wright, Armistead, Garnett, Kemper, Semmes, Wofford, Anderson, Rodes’, Early’s and Johnson’s troops actually wear? (Jensen; Fremantle; regimental histories; museum objects.)
14. What did Lee, Longstreet, A.P. Hill, Ewell, Pickett, Armistead and Stuart wear at Gettysburg, and what was the uniform of Blackford’s battalion? (Fremantle; photographs; Blackford report.)
15. Which regiments actually wore corps badges in July 1863, and what are the XII Corps, Cavalry Corps and Artillery Reserve badge shapes? (Dyer, Bates, NPS.)
16. What was the dress of the Irish Brigade, Philadelphia Brigade, 20th Maine, 16th Michigan and the 72nd PA in July 1863? (Regimental histories; museum objects.)

17. What were the Union cavalry headgear regulations (Hardee hat cord and feather), boots, guidon patterns, and the Confederate cavalry arms and horse types? (1861 regulations; museum objects; photographs.)

18. Which proportion of Union enlisted men wore frock coats versus sack coats, and what do Columbus Depot and Richmond Depot jacket types imply for specific brigades? (Jensen; museum objects.) Artillery 19. What are the Blakely 12-pdr specifications, the per-elevation range tables for each gun, the limber and caisson chest rounds and recoil distance, and which battery held the 24-pdr howitzers? (Gibbon’s manual; 1861 Ordnance Manual; ordnance returns.)

20. What were the gun counts, positions, times and losses of Weir, Thomas, Cowan, Stevens, Wiedrich, Winegar, Rugg, Kinzie, Atwell, Seeley, Clark, Winslow, Watson and Hazard’s batteries, and the Confederate battalion gun counts (Henry, Dearing, Cabell, Garnett, Poague, Pegram, Walton)? (Hunt, Tyler, Alexander and battalion reports.)

21. What were the Union and Confederate expenditures of rounds and the casualty and gun-loss figures from the July 3 barrage? (Hunt; Alexander; Eshleman.) Terrain, structures and works 22. Who built the East Cemetery Hill lunettes, when, and to what dimensions; what works existed on West Cemetery Hill and in Evergreen Cemetery? (Howard, Wainwright and Hunt reports; NPS CLR.)

23. When and by whom were the Cemetery Ridge rail breastworks built (Hays, Gibbon, Hancock), and what did Lockwood’s, Kane’s and Greene’s brigades build at Culp’s Hill, with what tools, thickness and headlog dimensions? (Hancock, Gibbon, Greene, Geary, Slocum reports.)

24. What were the road surfaces, widths and grades for the Chambersburg Pike, Hagerstown, Fairfield, Emmitsburg, Hanover, York, Harrisburg, Carlisle, Mummasburg and Millerstown roads, the Plum Run crossings, Granite Schoolhouse Lane and the Rock Creek bridges? (Warren map; NPS CLRs.)

25. What is the fence type, height and damage state per segment along the Emmitsburg Road and elsewhere, and what do the 1868 damage claims say? (Gettysburg Daily post and Emerging Civil War post cited in Sources are leads; State damage claims; NPS CLR.)
26. What are the “Brian barn” lane, Powers Hill emplacements, Warren’s engineer and pioneer details, tool inventories and Bachelder maps of works? (Bachelder; Official Records.)

27. What are the positional error (RMS) of the Warren map, its tree and orchard symbology, and whether NPS makes its 1863 GIS layers public? (NPS; NARA.) Vegetation and environment 28. What were the crop type, height and state per field on each date (including the Wheatfield), the grass height, and the peach/cherry/apple fruit state? (Pfanz; NPS CLR; 1860 census; damage claims.)

29. What was the species composition, canopy and undergrowth of the Plum Run Slaughter Pen, Culp’s Hill forest, Big Round Top and Devil’s Den, and how did chestnut loss change the canopy? (NPS vegetation inventory; Pfanz; Frassanito.)
30. What were the humidity, dew point, pressure and visibility, and which wind speed is correct (12 versus 2 mph)? (Signal Corps and Jacobs observations; NOAA reconstructions.)

31. What was the Gettysburg-specific acoustic evidence and the Ellis attribution, and the date of the Pittsburgh claim? (Acoustic literature; NPS.) Hospitals and medical 32. What were the counts and names of Confederate hospitals beyond the Seminary, McPherson barn and Lady farm; the texts of the II, VI, XI and XII Corps hospital tablets; the roles of the Brian farm, Sheads, Blocher, Henry Culp, Spangler’s Spring, Michael Fiscel, Pitzer, Black Horse Tavern, Marsh Creek and Hagerstown Road barns, the courthouse and German Reformed church? (Coco; Letterman; NPS markers.)
33. What was Hunter McGuire’s role and what were the Bishop wagon trains’ details? (Medical histories.)

34. What were the Soldiers’ National Cemetery burial counts and the dedication details, and what photographs of hospitals exist (LOC “U.S. Christian Commission at Gettysburg General Hospital”)? (LOC; NPS.)

35. What were Camp Letterman’s exact opening and closing dates? (Letterman; Civil War Medicine museum.) Library, method and tooling 36. How many reports are in vol. 27 Parts 1-3, is eHistory complete for serials 043-045, and what are its crawling terms; how do HathiTrust Data API and HTRC bulk rules apply? (Site terms; Hathi documentation.)
37. Do public-domain Internet Archive scans of OR vol. 27 with downloadable text exist (the verified items are flagged private)? Is vol. 27 transcribed on Wikisource?
38. Which OR Atlas plates cover Gettysburg, and which Hotchkiss maps exist? (OR Atlas; LOC.)

39. Is any period-specific musket-loading motion data or public-domain reenactment drill video available under a usable licence; what are the Truebones, Rokoko Vision, MediaPipe and MotionGPT licences? (Licence pages.)
40. What black-powder-specific acoustics studies exist, and what are BBC Sound Effects and Freesound access terms for scripted use? (Licence pages; acoustics literature.)

41. Does Smithsonian Open Access hold CC0 Civil War uniform or arms scans; what is the current Fab/Megascans licence status; can Unreal Engine be installed headless without an Epic Launcher login? (Smithsonian; Fab; Epic documentation.)

42. What are the exact headless render flags and resume behavior for the chosen engine, and what do the owner’s hardware limits (VRAM, thermal, power) allow? (Engine documentation; first measured benchmark.)
